content: Namba Jemesa Anatu Kamongo Yesu Koraisapana kendemande ingyuo karo. Nakama rara akalisa mendaki dee ipisu lama bolombalo lao yuu wakale wakale dupwana peyaminyi dokona lao yako lao pyao jilyu.
Randa Eparamopa Mee Kalyinyi Pyambuo Karalapape
Yangonemoo, nakama keta makande pingi wakale wakale dupwame epo randa jiya kande dokopa rae maingi renge epelyamo lao suu pyalapape.
Nakamana Anatu kapa ingingi lao suu pingi dokona mendeme makande piramo dokome nakama poraiyuo andanyi pyambwarasa pira doko silyaminyi.
Nakama kaeya napala pyuoko kararami dokopa rolae angi ingyuo karapala mendena nakama yangyaramo kara narami.
Mendeme singinya renge doko mwuara ramo doko baa Anatu piso seramo dokopa maira. Anatumi wambu peparae kando daa laa nao mona keyange palyapala mee maiyamoko maingi.

Mendeme jinya lao piso soo dokopa baa kapa ingyara lao suu pyapala, suu pingi lamana manjo piso see nana. Suu pingi lama palyuo karenge dupwa ipwa pete poo letamo dokopa kapu kyilya kapu kyana pyuo karenge dopale ingilyamo.
Akali dopale Kamongome mende mairamo nyero lao suu pyaa nana.
Baa suu pingi lamana palyuo kyakao paenge akali dopale ingyuo karamo.
Akali Pendewa Kamongope
Anatumi akali kuki dupwa nyuo ketae pyambwaramo dokopa rae wakasa maiyuo karenale.
Dee akali kamongo dupwa Anatumi kuki inginyi pyambwaramo dokopa rae maiyuo karenale. Paunya isoko jingi loo lao isa penge doko makande minyuo akali kamongona yulu dupwa mee isa pasi sera.

Neta andake rao yando naramo dokopa jingi rao rakusi rapala loo lao isa paramopa banya au pyuo rao singi doko mee isa pasi sera. Dopako pyuo akali kamongonge dupwa anda kanya dokona mee kumaramisa nakamana bange dupwa mee kulimbwaro karara.

Mendeme randa eparamopa mee kalyinyi pyambuo kararamo doko baa rae maiyuo para. Baa keta makande pingi wakale wakale eparamopa mee kalyinyi pyambuo karara dokopa Anatumi baa mona retenge wambu dupwa keta kyakana renge mairu lalu lao leya doko nyera.

Mendali keta makande pingi dupwa eparamo dokopa Anatumi namba makande pipyamo karo lao laa nana. Koo dupwame Anatu kapa makande pyuo pii nange. Dee Anatumi wambu mendali keta koo dupwame alya minyuo makande pyuo pii nangeoko.
Namwa rangena koo wangu lakao suu pingi dokome namwa epe epe pyuo nyilyamo.
Namwa koo mende pinya suu pilyamanosa doko wambo ene wai lyepala enakana yulu koo ando penge. Ando kaelyo lao dokopa namwa kumasinyi nembara.
Yangonemoo rangeme range minyakongo lao kara nalapape.

Bange ama keyange yapasi namwa keta epenge dupwa yake panda dokonako piso epenge. Yakena neta kanape rao karamo dupwana Rakane baameoko keyange dupwa joo karenge. Baame yuu peparae mee yanga paupau lao karo neta kapu kyepala anda pao dokopa yuu kone pupuripi pingi dopale ingyuope alowa pii nange.
Baa range suu piyamuli pyuo waili pii angi kulisa dokome namwa waso nyiya. Wasiyamo lapo dupwana namwako isa jingi mupwasa kanda soo lyingi dopale lao wasiya.
Anatunya Pii Soo Manjipala Pipwape

Yangone Rakanemoo nakama pii dake kame see nalapape. Nakama peparae pii dupwa kale yukupala soo karalapa. Doko nakama mee sipurapala pii waiya lao laa nao, dee imbwualana wangu lakapala waiya lao imbwuako pii nalapape.
Imbu singi dokome Anatunya yulu rolae dokona nyisarasa pii nara.

Dokona lao yulu kwaengepe dee yulu koo waiya lao andelyamo dupwa nembo kaeyalapape. Anatu laramuli pyuo warombo soo pisipala, banya pii nakama lete nyeramo doko baame mona anda palyakayamo doko soo manjo nyelapapae.
Banya pii doko nakama range dokona mee ketae sepala rangeme range kando kyambo lao kara nalapape. Dopa pyuo pii napala banya yulu angingyuo pyuo karalapape.
Banya pii doko mee kalena ketae sepala angingyuo pii nange wambu dupwame akali mende banya lenge kambu ketapa dokona range kandenge dopale ingyuo pelyaminyi.
Ketapa kandapala enakana nyuo ope api pokolyasa apiyakalende kandapu lao suu pyaa nange.

Akali mendeme lowa keyange yapasi wambu kiiramo nyingi dokona poraiyuo sepala karo mee kalena ketae angi sepa nae naepe, waiya lao kame soo kara nangende ramo doko Anatumi nyisaramopa raeme kumuo para.

Api mendeme range dokona namba sukusa akali anginde karalyamo kae lao masilyase? Wambu dopale doko kambunya pii dupwa range yama pyuo minya nara ramo doko range minya kongole lao lao kararasa pira. Dokome banya sukusa yulu dupwa isa para.

Rakange Anatumi Kurisene yulu angi yapasi lao suu pyao karamo dusipa dopale. Wane wanake muiyane dee enda waiya dupwana randa eparamo dokopa nyisarami. Dee yongona yulu dupwa andanyi nembapala kokwa sisara lao waso karalapape letamo.
